<div class="card-body">
'''Kessel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[System]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ケッセル</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：戦闘運命数を引くのに、能力値の合計が６以上必要。ダークサイド：自分の宇宙船は、配備コスト－１（ターキンがいるのなら、配備コスト－２）。自分が支配しているのなら、「ケッセル・ラン」を妨げる（キャンセルされる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-288o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Kessel.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: Total ability of 6 or more is required to draw battle destiny. Dark Side: Your starships are deploy -1, or deploy -2 if Tarkin is here. If you control, prevent Kessel Run by canceling it.

'''Lore:''' 

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese reduces deploy if Tarkin is here; the English requires Tarkin aboard a starship here.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99.
